notes: Proxy list truncated to 10,000 rows: — `IPCManager.tsx` dispatched `fetchProxies({ limit: 10000 })` after every check/grab completion, overwriting the full proxy list with only 10,000 rows. Fixed by removing the hardcoded limit so all proxies load correctly. | Proxy Checker table capped at 10,000 rows: — removed `slice(0, 10000)` from table rendering so all loaded proxies are visible. | Total proxy count mismatch between Dashboard and Proxy Checker: — Proxy Checker now uses the `fetchProxies` thunk (which sets both `proxies` and `totalProxies`) instead of raw `db.query` + `setProxies` (which only set `proxies`).
